voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

chunks.text: When a friend of yours turns to you to talk about his or her problems, you give advice and help.
One important thing of our growth is to make decisions to help our friends and learn to support each other.
This requires us to learn what it means to help friends and how to help in the right way.
This is just like a nurse giving proper care to the patients.
The first step towards helping others is to identify that they need help.
We all know that difficulties are part of our daily lives.
However, sometimes small things can lead to more serious problems.
If someone is crying, it's clear that they may not be well.
Yet you may as well pick up small signs that your friends are not acting like themselves.
Maybe they're being bullied but shy about their problems.
Just remind them that you're there to help.
They'll be glad if you give them a hug and ask what is going on.
The next step is to listen.
Listening to others is very important throughout our life.
We need to learn when to speak and when not to.
Just like any lady or gentleman would.
As listeners, we should try to see things from their perspectives.
Listening is a sign of respect and an important skill.
Finally, when helping friends, consider practical support such as doing the chores for them or bringing them a plate of food.
Maintaining a positive manner and showing real joy in helping others can lead to deeper relationships and make you a better person.
